SECTION_A_ORCHESTRATOR.title: Section A: Runtime Orchestrator Verification
SECTION_A_ORCHESTRATOR.description: Validates task DAG orchestration, cycle detection, worker allocation, state checkpoints, crash recovery, and idempotency keys.

assertions.name: DAG_Construction_And_Cycle_Detection
assertions.message: DAG topological ordering and cycle detection verified successfully.

assertions.name: Worker_Allocation_And_Throttling
assertions.message: Worker concurrency throttling respected (Cap=5, Peak=1).

assertions.name: Checkpoints_And_Crash_Recovery
assertions.message: Crash recovery from checkpoint resumed precisely without re-running prior steps.

assertions.name: Task_Deduplication_And_Idempotency
assertions.message: Idempotency deduplication verified (Filtered 4 duplicates, 3 executions).

SECTION_B_AGENT_KERNEL.title: Section B: Agent Runtime Kernel Verification
SECTION_B_AGENT_KERNEL.description: Validates agent lifecycle state machines, context memory window budgeting, infinite loop detection/mitigation, and hierarchical sub-agent tree execution.

assertions.name: Agent_Goal_Lifecycle_State_Machine
assertions.message: Agent goal lifecycle transitions strictly conform to state machine specifications.

assertions.name: Memory_And_Context_Window_Budget_Pruning
assertions.message: Context budget enforced: Pruned from 5500 to 3500 tokens (Budget: 4000).

assertions.name: Infinite_Loop_And_Repetition_Breaker
assertions.message: Infinite loop breaker tripped after detecting repeated identical action patterns.

assertions.name: SubAgent_Spawning_And_Hierarchical_Cleanup
assertions.message: Sub-agent hierarchy managed and terminated cleanly (3 subagents cleaned).

SECTION_C_WORKFLOW_ENGINE.title: Section C: Workflow DAG Engine Verification
SECTION_C_WORKFLOW_ENGINE.description: Validates workflow conditional routing, parallel fan-out/fan-in barriers, human-in-the-loop pause/resume gates, and saga compensation rollbacks.

assertions.name: Workflow_Conditional_Branching
assertions.message: Workflow correctly evaluated conditional logic and selected 'HIGH_VALUE_AUDIT_BRANCH'.

assertions.name: Parallel_FanOut_FanIn_Barrier_Sync
assertions.message: Fan-out parallel execution synchronized cleanly at fan-in barrier (4 chunks).

assertions.name: Human_In_The_Loop_Pause_Resume_Gates
assertions.message: Workflow paused safely at HITL gate and resumed correctly upon valid authorization.

assertions.name: Saga_Distributed_Transaction_Compensations
assertions.message: Saga failure triggered exact reverse compensation sequence (3 steps compensated).

SECTION_D_SCHEDULER.title: Section D: Task Scheduler Verification
SECTION_D_SCHEDULER.description: Validates cron/interval scheduling calculations, exponential backoff with jitter, distributed lease/lock expiration, and missed schedule catch-up policies.

assertions.name: Cron_And_Interval_Schedule_Calculation
assertions.message: Schedule interval intervals calculated with zero drift across 5 occurrences.

assertions.name: Exponential_Backoff_With_Jitter
assertions.message: Exponential backoff with full jitter tested across 5 retries (Bounded by 32.0s).

assertions.name: Distributed_Lock_Lease_Expiration
assertions.message: Distributed lease expired cleanly and reassigned to secondary worker without deadlock.

assertions.name: Missed_Schedule_CatchUp_Coalesce_Policy
assertions.message: Coalesced 3 missed schedule runs into single execution preventing queue deluge.

SECTION_E_QUEUES.title: Section E: Messaging Queue & Ingestion Verification
SECTION_E_QUEUES.description: Validates FIFO queue preservation, priority lane dispatching, dead-letter queue (DLQ) poison isolation, and producer backpressure flow control.

assertions.name: Strict_FIFO_Ordering_Preservation
assertions.message: Strict FIFO ordering verified across 50 sequential messages.

assertions.name: Priority_Queue_Lane_Routing
assertions.message: Priority queue correctly dequeued P0 critical events ahead of P1 and P2 standard events.

assertions.name: DLQ_Poison_Message_Isolation
assertions.message: Poison message isolated to DLQ after 3 retries without blocking healthy queue.

assertions.name: Producer_Backpressure_Flow_Control
assertions.message: Producer backpressure activated at depth 105 (High watermark: 100).

SECTION_F_STORAGE.title: Section F: Distributed Storage & Document Store Verification
SECTION_F_STORAGE.description: Validates object storage, document metadata indexing, tenant quota enforcement, SHA-256 deduplication, bit-rot checksum detection, and lifecycle retention.

assertions.name: Blob_Store_And_Metadata_Indexing
assertions.message: Blob store indexed 10 documents with complete schema metadata.

assertions.name: Tenant_Storage_Quota_Enforcement
assertions.message: Storage quota hard cap enforced: Rejected write exceeding 10MB quota.

assertions.name: Content_Addressed_SHA256_Deduplication
assertions.message: SHA-256 deduplication compressed 7 document refs into 2 unique blobs (3.50x efficiency).

assertions.name: BitRot_And_Checksum_Integrity_Validation
assertions.message: Cryptographic SHA-256 checksum comparison detected simulated single-byte data corruption immediately.

SECTION_G_API_GATEWAY.title: Section G: API Layer & Gateway Verification
SECTION_G_API_GATEWAY.description: Validates REST schema validation, token bucket rate limiting (429), multipart stream ingestion, and RFC 7807 problem details error responses.

assertions.name: API_Request_Response_Schema_Validation
assertions.message: API Gateway strict JSON schema validation accepted valid payload and rejected malformed types.

assertions.name: Token_Bucket_Rate_Limiting_429
assertions.message: Rate limiter correctly throttled burst requests with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

assertions.name: Multipart_Chunk_Streaming_Reassembly
assertions.message: Multipart stream successfully reassembled 4 chunks (46 bytes).

assertions.name: RFC7807_Problem_Details_Error_Standard
assertions.message: API error responses conform strictly to RFC 7807 Problem Details specification.

problem_details.title: Document Not Found
problem_details.detail: The requested document 'doc_9999' was not found in tenant repository.

SECTION_H_EVENT_BUS.title: Section H: Event Bus & Messaging Verification
SECTION_H_EVENT_BUS.description: Validates domain/integration event schemas, pub-sub fan-out delivery, event deduplication, and chronological audit event replay.

assertions.name: CloudEvents_Schema_Envelope_Specification
assertions.message: Event bus envelope conforms to CloudEvents 1.0 specification with strict metadata typing.

assertions.name: PubSub_Topic_FanOut_Broadcast

assertions.name: Chronological_Event_Sourcing_State_Replay
assertions.message: Replayed 4 chronological events to reconstruct identical historical entity state.

SECTION_I_CONFIG_SECRETS.title: Section I: Configuration & Secrets Verification
SECTION_I_CONFIG_SECRETS.description: Validates configuration layering precedence, dynamic hot-reloading with validation, secret redaction/masking in logs, and zero-downtime secret rotation.

assertions.name: Layered_Configuration_Precedence_Hierarchy
assertions.message: Configuration precedence correctly layered: Defaults < File < Env < Secrets.

assertions.name: Dynamic_Hot_Reload_And_Rollback_Validation
assertions.message: Dynamic config hot-reload applied valid changes and rejected malformed updates without downtime.

assertions.name: Secret_Masking_And_Redaction_In_Logs
assertions.message: Sanitized log stream: Redacted 3 sensitive secret fields before telemetry export.

assertions.name: Zero_Downtime_DualKey_Secret_Rotation
assertions.message: Dual-key grace window verified: Old and new keys accepted concurrently during rotation phase.

SECTION_J_CACHING.title: Section J: Caching Layer Verification
SECTION_J_CACHING.description: Validates L1/L2 tiered caching, TTL precision, cache stampede mutex locking, and LRU eviction under memory capacity limits.

assertions.name: Tiered_L1_L2_Cache_Architecture
assertions.message: Tiered cache verified: L1 miss fell back to L2, backfilled L1, subsequent request hit L1.

assertions.name: TTL_Cache_Expiration_Precision
assertions.message: TTL expiration verified: Active key returned valid payload, expired key returned cache miss.

assertions.name: Cache_Stampede_SingleFlight_Locking
assertions.message: Single-flight locking coalesced 20 concurrent requests into 1 single database query.

assertions.name: LRU_Cache_Eviction_Under_Capacity_Limits
assertions.message: LRU eviction purged oldest accessed key (k2) when capacity exceeded 3.

SECTION_K_IDENTITY_AUTH.title: Section K: Identity, Auth & Session Verification
SECTION_K_IDENTITY_AUTH.description: Validates JWT token signature lifecycle, granular RBAC role authorization, cryptographic multi-tenant context isolation, and instant session revocation blacklists.

assertions.name: JWT_Signature_Lifecycle_And_Rotation

assertions.name: Granular_RBAC_Role_Authorization

assertions.name: MultiTenant_Cryptographic_Context_Isolation

assertions.name: Instant_Session_Revocation_Blacklist

assertions.name: Cascading_Timeout_Deadline_Propagation
